name: Handia (Rice Beer)
ingredients: Ranu tablet (a traditional herbal starter culture containing various roots and barks)
instructions: 1. Boil the parboiled rice in water until it is cooked but still firm.
2. Drain the water and spread the cooked rice on a clean surface to cool down completely.
3. Grind the Ranu tablets into a fine powder.
4. Thoroughly mix the Ranu powder into the cooled rice.
5. Transfer the mixture into a clean earthen pot (handi) and cover it tightly.
6. Store the pot in a cool, dark place for 2 to 3 days to allow the fermentation process to occur.
7. Once the mixture turns liquid and develops a distinct sweet-sour aroma, strain the liquid and serve chilled.
description: Handia is a traditional fermented rice beverage indigenous to the tribal communities of Jharkhand. It holds deep cultural and social significance, often prepared during festivals, weddings, and community gatherings. It is considered a cooling drink and is regarded as a sacred offering to the ancestors and spirits.
